hypothesis: Implement O(N) sliding window sum instead of O(N*W) slicing and summing

hypothesis: Cache len() and list methods to local variables inside the loop to reduce attribute lookup overhead
rationale: In tight loops, repeated attribute access (len(), append()) has measurable overhead in CPython. Local variable caching can shave a few percent off runtime without changing algorithm.
